description: Parse a JSON wire document back into a portlet collection and report the reconstructed state as a deterministic dump giving the portlet count and, per portlet in document order, its identifier, class, parameter count, and each parameter as a sorted name/value line. These cases exercise boundary inputs: an empty collection, a record with no initialization parameters, a record whose wire parameters are supplied out of sorted order, and a collection of several records.

cases.expected_output:
portlets=1
[0] id=sorting
[0] class=com.dotcms.Sort
[0] init_count=3
[0] init.alpha=a
[0] init.mu=m
[0] init.zeta=z

portlets=2
[0] id=one

[0] init_count=1
[0] init.a=1
